_about: B / C for a factory preset new in presets.c, by its name: tools/gen_move_presets.py --sync takes them when the preset first appears (B / C = its A with "set", P_LEVEL = A's + level_delta) and moves them into variants.json. B: tools/f01_search.py final19's alternative (level-matched by its critical-band search on the build it ran on). C: a variant rule the factory preset review used on a like preset, its level step taken over (2026-11-10, host HQ build, critical-band loudness of a phrase re A: WARM77 ECHO -0.13 dB, PUNCH TAPE -0.14, LUSH DARK +0.14, DRIVE BODY -0.18; the B: -0.12, -0.14, +0.05, +0.02).

WARM 77.note: New in the proposed 19 (FINAL19, 2026-11-10): the warm 77, dry.

B.name: WARM77 FAT
B.line: a firmer compressor (3:1, faster attack, longer release), more hall
B.desc: FINAL19's alternative (A FAT 77): CMP AMT 36, ATK 40, RATIO 3, REL 96; hall 18, LOW CUT 70

C.name: WARM77 ECHO
C.line: a soft dark analog echo on the quarter note, a little more hall
C.desc: F01 B's rule: ANA 1/4, mix 10, feedback 24, tone 46; hall 10 -> 12

WARM 77.why: B is the search's own alternative; C the review's echo on a dry 77.

PUNCH 77.note: New in the proposed 19 (FINAL19, 2026-11-10): the punchy 77.

B.name: VINTAGE 77
B.line: darker and softer: less bell and hammer, a gentle compressor, a plate
B.desc: FINAL19's alternative (A VINTAGE 77): TONE 64, BELL 48, HAMMER 48, CMP 50 / 1 / 80 / 96, PLATE 22, LOW CUT 80

C.name: PUNCH TAPE
C.line: a tape echo on the dotted 1/8, a slightly bigger hall
C.desc: F01 C's rule: TAPE 8D, mix 13, feedback 32, tone 54; hall 18 -> 22, pre-delay 20

PUNCH 77.why: C keeps the punch and adds the echo; B is a different (vintage) piano.

LUSH CHO.note: New in the proposed 19 (FINAL19, 2026-11-10): chorus, a dotted-1/8 tape echo, a plate.

B.name: LUSH SOFT
B.line: a softer bark, a gentler compressor, a shorter decay
B.desc: FINAL19's alternative (pick 1): BARK 64, CMP AMT 50, ATK 80, DECAY 64

C.name: LUSH DARK
C.line: a slower chorus, a darker analog echo on the quarter note
C.desc: F07 C's rule: CP SPEED 44 -> 36; ANA 1/4, feedback 46, tone 50

LUSH CHO.why: B is the search's own alternative; C the ballad's darker echo.

WARM DRIVE.note: New in the proposed 19 (FINAL19, 2026-11-10): a warm drive, chorus, a dotted-1/8 tape echo, a plate.

B.name: DRIVE SOFT
B.line: a softer bark, a gentler compressor
B.desc: FINAL19's alternative (pick 1): BARK 64, CMP RATIO 1, ATK 80

C.name: DRIVE BODY
C.line: more drive and body, a longer tape slap
C.desc: F06 C's rule: drive 40 -> 46, drive tone 70 -> 64, the tape a little longer (mix 14, feedback 36)

WARM DRIVE.why: B is the search's own alternative; C the driven 77's body.
